Path 2, toolsGOALS §3.5

Model Context Protocol

The standard way an agent reaches a tool, and the thing we have to govern.

WHAT IT IS

An open protocol for exposing tools and data to models. MCP servers wrap an API or system; clients like Claude Code or our own agents call them.

WHAT SETS IT APART

One integration works across agents and models. The risk is the default: a server inherits whatever credentials the person who started it had. 34 sessions this year were about running MCP safely.

WHERE WE STAND

Adopt as the tool interface, with servers run centrally as cluster workloads behind the MCP gateway.

MCP track and Agentics Day, KubeCon NA 2026
